title: transit Config has stale allow(dead_code)
description: crates/transit/src/config.rs line 79-81: Config struct has #[allow(dead_code)] with comment 'server logic will consume them as epics are implemented.' The server is implemented and these fields are consumed. The blanket allow(dead_code) suppresses real compiler warnings and implies the struct is mostly unused. Remove it; annotate only genuinely unused fields with a scoped allow and explanation.
